info.name: KB Knowledge Graph Engine
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the KB Knowledge Graph Engine API.

Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8001

All knowledge graph endpoints including query, node traversal, search, stats, tools, chapters, and health.

variable.description: Base URL of the running API server

request.description: Returns service status. Useful to verify the server is up before sending queries.

Main query endpoint. Runs the full LangGraph agent pipeline (classify_intent → locate_entry_nodes → traverse_graph → build_steps → resolve_tools → synthesize_response) and returns a structured answer.

**Request fields:**
- `query` (string, required) — Natural-language question to ask the knowledge graph.
- `stream` (boolean, optional, default `false`) — Reserved for future streaming support.

**Response fields:**
- `query` — Echo of the original query.
- `intent` — Classified intent: `process`, `tool_lookup`, `concept`, or `general`.
- `kb_focus` — Which KB was used: `knowledge`, `tool`, or `both`.
- `extracted_topics` — Key topics extracted from the query.
- `response` — Full synthesized narrative answer (markdown-formatted).
- `steps` — Ordered list of process steps with `title`, `description`, and `system` fields.
- `tools_referenced` — Tools found during traversal with `tool_name`, `provider`, `purpose`, `category`.
- `knowledge_concepts` — Related knowledge concepts with `node_id`, `title`, `kb_source`.
- `follow_up_suggestions` — 3 suggested follow-up questions.
- `traversal_path` — Ordered list of node IDs visited by the agent.
- `error` — null on success; error message string if something failed.

request.description: Hybrid semantic + keyword search across all graph nodes. Returns nodes with a `search_score`.

BFS traversal from any node.

**Request fields:**
- `node_id` (string, required) — Starting node ID.
- `max_depth` (integer, optional, default 3) — How many hops to traverse.
- `edge_types` (array of strings, optional) — Filter traversal to specific edge types. Valid types: `CONTAINS`, `USES_TOOL`, `HAS_CONTENT`, `NEXT_STEP`, `RELATED_TO`, `INTEGRATES_WITH`, `IMPLEMENTS`.

**Response fields:**
- `root_node_id` — Starting node.
- `traversal_path` — Ordered list of visited node IDs.
- `nodes` — Full node data for each visited node.
- `edge_count` — Number of edges within the traversal subgraph.
